newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Most Singapore murders are crimes of passion -paper.
newsitem.headline: Most Singapore murders are crimes of passion -paper.

text.p: Love kills when passions run high in Singapore according to police figures reported in the Sunday Times which showed more than half of the murders in the tiny island republic in 1996 were crimes of the heart.

"Although the total murder rate has fallen in recent years, there has been a growing number of cases in which people suddenly snapped and killed their spouses, lovers and others close to them," the Sunday Times said.
Police figures show that 55 percent of the 31 murders committed in Singapore in 1996 were crimes of passion, up from 1995's ratio of 51 percent of 51 murders.
The ratio stood at 40 percent a decade ago, the paper said.
The statistics could come as an eye-opener to those outside observers who view Singapore as a sterile place.

Cases quoted by the paper included that of 25 year-old panel beater who clubbed his wife's supervisor to death with a crash helmet after flying into a jealous rage when he saw the man put his arm around her shoulders.
